name: configure_safety
description: Configures safety settings, failsafe corner abort, physical mouse contention detection, speed limiter, and Picture-in-Picture virtual desktop mode.

contention.description: Enable or disable physical user mouse movement contention yield.

desktop_mode.description: Desktop isolation mode: 'interactive' (standard foreground execution) or 'isolated_pip' (runs in background PiP sandbox without moving user's mouse).

failsafe.description: Enable or disable (0, 0) top-left corner failsafe.
